subject: Taxes
title: The OECD's Global Framework
description: A quick, practical guide to The OECD's Global Framework.

hook.text: The OECD launched the Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework in 2023.

buildup.text: CARF mirrors the Common Reporting Standard that ended bank secrecy. It's the same playbook applied to crypto exchanges.

discovery.text: Under CARF, exchanges must report users' names, addresses, tax IDs.

twist.text: 47 countries adopted CARF for implementation by 2027. The era of crypto tax anonymity has an official end date.

climax.text: CARF will create a global surveillance network for crypto. Every exchange, every trade, reported to every government.

punchline.text: 47 countries, one framework. Global crypto tax reporting starts by 2027.

quiz.question: What does the OECD's CARF require?
options: Exchanges to share user data across borders for tax purposes
